title: Released 3D consumer route refresh: OpenCADStudio 2026.42 and ACIS evidence ceilings
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source review; research-only plan update
scope: Refresh the newly released OpenCADStudio SAT/ACIS import and distinguish it from the project's DWG/DXF read/render route and same-codec save verification.
Cross-check the candidate's codec lineage and evidence ceiling against the existing cq-acis, FreeCAD, OCCT, LibreDWG, and ACadSharp lanes.
Refine the optional composed semantic/application gate without adding per-slice validation, dependencies, fixtures, or external-only status changes.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project release notes, documentation, issues, and existing local plan entries
method.limitations: Release notes and README claims identify candidate routes, not runtime behavior or complete entity/profile support. No OpenCADStudio SAT import, embedded DXF solid import, DWG AcDs conversion, FreeCAD run, or cq-acis parser/conversion was executed. Geometry semantics, native acceptance, and exact outer DWG entity-to-AcDs association remain unqualified by this review.

sources.revision: Release v2026.42 at b6fbac3, dated 2026-10-18; mutable README and docs reviewed the same date
sources.observed: Release notes add an IMPORT workflow for SAT/ACIS. The project separately advertises native DWG/DXF read/write and ACIS-entity tessellation. Public release notes do not define the exact embedded-solid/profile matrix or a stable per-body semantic measurement API. Automation save_verified reopens output with the application codec; plugin metadata fingerprints acadrust_source, so this route must be tied to the exact codec build and not counted as an independent sibling-codec vote.
sources.evidenceClass: primary release documentation and application contract; no binary or runtime tested

sources.revision: Existing plan-pinned PyPI 0.3.12 source/artifact entry; mutable project documentation refreshed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The project documents an experimental separately implemented SAT/SAB parser and bounded conversion subset, including ACIS BinaryFile 21800 and selected ASM versions. It distinguishes limited native SAB coverage from synthetic BinaryFile8 framing, retains unknown records, and uses CadQuery/OpenCascade for shape conversion. This is source-distinct parsing with a kernel family shared by FreeCAD, not a complete DWG/AcDs reader or independent-kernel result. Its corpus has separate provenance/license records and is not an admitted libdxfrw fixture source by default.
sources.evidenceClass: primary project/API documentation and existing artifact pin; no package installed or executed

sources.revision: Issue #1195 reports ACadSharp 3.4.9; PR #1240 remains a separate linked branch
sources.observed: The issue reports 3DSOLID/REGION entities read from DWG but silently omitted by DxfWriter, including solids inside blocks. The customer files are confidential and were not obtained. The report reinforces separate per-record disposition and carrier-preservation checks; it does not reproduce a libdxfrw defect or show that the open PR is released.
sources.evidenceClass: primary peer issue and PR status; no attachment, branch, or runtime used

sources.observed: The documented stock DXF importer cannot read embedded ACIS/SAT solids; issue #18454 was closed as not planned for ACIS solid import. FreeCAD remains an appropriate platform-qualified 2D/explicit-face consumer, not a stock ACIS semantic oracle.
sources.evidenceClass: current project documentation and issue disposition; no FreeCAD runtime run

sources.observed: Official project material separates the open-source OCCT core from commercial ACIS SAT/SAB exchange components; a stock OCCT/FreeCAD install cannot be assumed to contain this reader.
sources.evidenceClass: official component licensing/scope documentation; no commercial component accessed

planCrosswalk.planUse: At most one composed-gate visual/application observation on locally generated bytes after pinning release binary, codec fingerprint, platform, exact import operation, warnings, and body disposition. Do not infer DXF embedded-solid or DWG AcDs support from standalone SAT import.

planCrosswalk.route: cq-acis 0.3.12 profile-bounded SAT/SAB parser and shape conversion
planCrosswalk.planUse: Verify the payload signature/version first; parse only an admitted profile; expose every raw/unsupported record and all-body disposition; compare with an independently written analytic manifest. No DWG AcDs owner/key parsing and no independent-kernel or FreeCAD-native claim.
Continue required native Linux/Windows qualification for common 2D and explicit 3DFACE routes. Do not make unsupported stock ACIS import a converter blocker or semantic gate.

assessment.planImpact: Added a release-pinned optional OpenCADStudio SAT/ACIS application-consumer candidate with a strict visual-versus-semantic evidence ceiling. Kept cq-acis as the optional exact-profile parser/analytic check and FreeCAD as a separate 2D/explicit-face platform gate. Added no routine peer runs, installs, fixtures, dependencies, local findings, or implementation blockers.
